summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Keep SearchWoot private. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal data; public terms restrict those uses. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch, monetization, or permission outreach. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress is evidenced by official Woot API/terms/support records, repository and configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy pages, and draft terms. No task closes because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep outreach unsent and do not change launch state, production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, or monetization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance; storage, caching, display, derivative, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture those settings without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory. No data-use item is clear or eligible for go-live.

Fleet compliance disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible work; blocked for public exposure or compliance-sensitive releases where site evidence fails or is unknown. Technical baseline reports 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown across 59 sites, with open banner, accept, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. This baseline is not legal certification. Repair site-specific consent/disclosure failures before affected monetization or launch decisions; incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker for ordinary reversible growth. Do not infer adult, age-sensitive, regulated, copyright, trademark, claims, or platform-policy status from domain names; escalate those issues only when supported by site content or evidence.

Analytics and revenue evidence remains bounded. Analytics data quality is yellow because some GA4/GSC permissions or collectors fail; repair the listed permissions/errors and do not treat unavailable sources as zero. Search Console permission errors are recorded for arttogogh.com, girlpain.com, and searchwoot.com. Amazon evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission; the commission is in an aggregate row and cannot be assigned to a site. Preserve site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, and causal lift as unknown until matching-period attribution and costs are reconciled.

Private or gated site decision: retain parked/private or preview-only status for scaffold and gated properties until the applicable site brief, compliance checklist, analytics/affiliate readiness, security evidence, owner record, accuracy controls, and launch decision are evidenced. No public publication, monetization expansion, or go-live approval is supported by the current snapshot.
